## Random Teleport

---


[Entity Action Types](https://0vergrown.github.io/Sync-Documentation-Website/?file=entity_actions/random_teleport)

Teleports an entity to a random location within a defined area, with configurable landing conditions and success/failure actions.

Type ID: `sync:random_teleport`

---

### Examples

```json
{
    "type": "sync:random_teleport",
    "area_width": 16.0,
    "area_height": 8.0,
    "heightmap": "world_surface",
    "landing_block_condition": {
        "type": "apoli:in_tag",
        "tag": "minecraft:dirt_like"
    },
    "success_action": {
        "type": "apoli:play_sound",
        "sound": "minecraft:entity.enderman.teleport"
    }
}
```
This example teleports the entity to a random dirt-like surface within 16 blocks horizontally and 8 blocks vertically.

title: Random Teleport (Entity Action) date: 2024-01-07

Random Teleport

Entity Action Types

Teleports an entity to a random location within a defined area, with configurable landing conditions and success/failure actions.

Type ID: sync:random_teleport

Fields

Field Type Default Description
area_width Float 8.0 The width of the teleport search area (diameter)
area_height Float 8.0 The height of the teleport search area (diameter)
heightmap Heightmap Type optional Optional heightmap type to find valid positions
attempts Integer (calculated) Number of random positions to try (defaults to area_width2 + area_height2)
landing_block_condition Block Condition optional Condition that landing block must satisfy
landing_condition Entity Condition optional Condition that the teleported entity must satisfy at landing location
landing_offset Vector [0, 0, 0] Offset from the found landing position
loaded_chunks_only Boolean true Whether to only teleport to already loaded chunks
success_action Entity Action optional Action to execute on successful teleport
fail_action Entity Action optional Action to execute if all attempts fail

Notes

  • The action will try multiple random positions until it finds a valid one or runs out of attempts
  • Default landing block condition requires a solid block
  • Default landing condition requires the entity to fit without collisions and not be in fluid

Examples

{
    "type": "sync:random_teleport",
    "area_width": 16.0,
    "area_height": 8.0,
    "heightmap": "world_surface",
    "landing_block_condition": {
        "type": "apoli:in_tag",
        "tag": "minecraft:dirt_like"
    },
    "success_action": {
        "type": "apoli:play_sound",
        "sound": "minecraft:entity.enderman.teleport"
    }
}

This example teleports the entity to a random dirt-like surface within 16 blocks horizontally and 8 blocks vertically.
